verdict.rationale: Devin's docs explicitly market autonomous bug repro-and-fix as a core capability, including Slack-triggered bug fixes (devin-docs-1, devin-docs-4/21, devin-docs-18). However, independent hands-on evidence shows a concrete counter-example: a widely cited benchmark reporting only 13.8% of issues actually resolved, plus critiques that demoed fixes were simple/cherry-picked and unlikely to generalize to real bug complexity (devin-comm-2, devin-comm-3, devin-comm-1). Missing for 10: independent reproduction of high success rates on real-world bug reports, more recent (post-2024) benchmark data refuting the low resolution rate.
